description: This file is a shell script used to extract the '.config' file from a kernel image, primarily for Linux kernels compiled with CONFIG_IKCONFIG. It includes functions to locate, decompress, and output the kernel configuration data.

methods.name: dump_config
methods.description: Attempts to locate and extract the kernel configuration data from the specified image, potentially decompressing it if necessary.

methods.name: try_decompress
methods.description: Tries to decompress the kernel image with various algorithms to retrieve the configuration data.
